services.name: Beginner Vegetable Gardening Workshop
services.summary: A hands-on start-to-finish workshop covering soil preparation, seed sowing, watering and pest care for first-time growers.
services.imageAlt: Volunteer showing a workshop group how to plant seedlings in a container

services.name: Composting and Soil Health Workshop
services.summary: Learn how to turn kitchen scraps and garden waste into free compost, including a troubleshooting session for smelly or slow bins.
services.imageAlt: Raised wooden vegetable bed filled with dark compost and young plants

services.name: Water-Wise Food Gardening
services.summary: Practical mulching, drip watering and bed-design techniques that keep vegetables alive through a Durban dry spell.
services.imageAlt: Long raised herb beds planted with drought-tolerant herbs

services.name: Seasonal Community Plot
services.summary: Your own 12 square metre bed, shared tools and water, plus a mentor who visits once a month to help with planning.
services.imageAlt: Rows of community vegetable beds growing leafy green crops

services.name: Raised Bed Plot with Tool Locker
services.summary: A waist-height raised bed for gardeners who cannot bend easily, with a locked locker for your own tools and seeds.
services.imageAlt: Raised vegetable beds built in front of a community building

services.name: School Garden Visit
services.summary: A guided garden visit for Grades 4 to 7 that links life science outcomes to planting, composting and tasting fresh food.
services.imageAlt: Young gardener pressing a seedling into prepared soil

services.name: Holiday Garden Club
services.summary: Five mornings of planting, cooking from the harvest and caring for the chickens, run by our youth facilitators.
services.imageAlt: Neighbours planting flowers together in a shared community garden

services.name: Corporate Volunteer Team Day
services.summary: Bring your team for a facilitated day of bed building, planting and harvesting, including a lunch made from garden produce.
services.imageAlt: Volunteer kneeling in a garden bed while planting young plants

services.name: Weekly Garden Volunteer Shift
services.summary: Join the Saturday work party. No experience needed, gloves and tools are provided and every volunteer takes home a harvest bag.
services.imageAlt: Crates of freshly harvested vegetables ready for the Saturday market

services.name: Harvest Market Sponsorship
services.summary: Your business is credited at our quarterly harvest market, and the funds cover stall fees for ten home growers.
services.imageAlt: Market stall table piled with oranges and seasonal produce
